name: Lust Paradise
source:
Welcome to Lust Paradise! A very lewd city where angels and demons aren't equal.. but you'll discover it through the eyes of our protagonist, a goat named.. what's his name again?

[From [url=https://hivers.itch.io/lust-paradise]Itch.io[/url]]
